summaries.name: getDiscoveryDate
summaries.summary: Returns the track’s discovery date. Use it when you need to retrieve this metadata, such as when formatting or displaying track details.

summaries.name: updateRate
summaries.summary: Updates the track’s rate value. Use this to apply a new rate setting during procedural track processing.

summaries.name: isAutocommit
summaries.summary: Checks whether autocommit is currently enabled for the track manager. Use this when code needs to branch on transaction behavior or determine whether changes are applied automatically.

summaries.name: getURL
summaries.summary: Returns the cover’s URL. Use it when you need to read the current `URL` value for comparison or other lookup logic, such as checking whether two covers point to the same address.

summaries.name: subList
summaries.summary: Returns a sublist of the queue’s items starting at the given index through the end, packaged as a new `ArrayList<StackItem>`. Use it when you need a procedural slice of the underlying list without modifying the original collection.

summaries.name: process
summaries.summary: Processes the supplied value to carry out the XML export workflow. Use this when you need XMLExporter to handle a value as part of its export procedure, such as processing a list of items from the device manager.

summaries.name: process
summaries.summary: Processes a value for XML export, converting the supplied item into the form needed by the exporter. It is used procedurally, for example when handling an `Album` item via `process((Album)item)`.

summaries.name: process
summaries.summary: Processes a value in the exporter’s XML workflow, likely handling an item such as an album during export. Use this method when you need XMLExporter to transform or emit a single object as part of its procedural processing pipeline.

summaries.name: process
summaries.summary: Processes the given value, likely converting or handling it as part of XML export. Use it when an XMLExporter needs to perform a procedural operation on an input item, such as `process((Album)item)`.

summaries.name: process
summaries.summary: Processes a value by applying the exporter’s internal XML-handling logic. It is used procedurally when exporting items, as in `process((Album)item);`.

summaries.name: process
summaries.summary: Processes the given value in the XML export workflow, likely handling one item at a time as part of writing out XML data. Use it when an `XMLExporter` needs to convert or emit a specific object, such as `process((Album)item);`.

summaries.name: process
summaries.summary: Processes the provided value by applying the XML export logic. This is used procedurally in the exporter, as in `process((Album)item);`.

summaries.name: process
summaries.summary: Processes the given value, likely handling it as part of XML export logic. Use it when an XMLExporter needs to transform or emit a supplied item during export, as in `process((Album)item);`.

summaries.name: perform
summaries.summary: Performs the action represented by this `GCAction`, typically using the supplied value as input. It is used when an action needs to be triggered procedurally, such as `ActionManager.getAction(JajukActions.EXIT).perform(null);`.

summaries.name: getItemAt
summaries.summary: Returns the `Item` at the specified position in the playlist table model. Use this when you need to retrieve a row’s backing item from the model by index.

summaries.name: handleSave
summaries.summary: Handles a save action for the `CoverView`, likely coordinating whatever state or view data needs to be persisted. It is used procedurally as part of save-related UI behavior, with a usage example of `handleSaveAs()`.

summaries.name: updateGUIFromConfCovers
summaries.summary: Updates the GUI to reflect the current configuration covers state. Use this when the parameter view needs to be synchronized with configuration changes, as in `updateGUIFromConfCovers()`.

summaries.name: getNothingFoundPanel
summaries.summary: Returns the “nothing found” panel used when there are no suggestion results to display. This is typically used as part of building the view, such as wrapping it in a scroll pane for presentation.

summaries.name: getID
summaries.summary: Returns the adapter’s ID as a String. Use it when code needs a stable identifier for this ViewAdapter, such as passing it into property-setting or lookup logic.

summaries.name: paint
summaries.summary: Paints the split pane’s value, overriding the default rendering to control its appearance. Use this method when the component needs custom drawing during Swing repainting.

summaries.name: JajukJSplitPane
summaries.summary: Creates and configures a `JajukJSplitPane` instance. This constructor is used when initializing the custom split pane component for the application’s UI layout.

summaries.name: getOptionPane
summaries.summary: Returns the dialog’s `JOptionPane` instance so callers can inspect or interact with the underlying option pane. Use this when you need access to the dialog’s configured Swing pane rather than the dialog itself.

summaries.name: closeSystray
summaries.summary: Closes and hides the application systray icon. Use it when shutting down or otherwise removing the tray presence, as in `jsystray.closeSystray();`.

summaries.name: WindowGlobalKeystrokeManager
summaries.summary: Creates a `WindowGlobalKeystrokeManager` instance for managing global keystroke handling. It is used as an object construction/assignment step, such as `self = new WindowGlobalKeystrokeManager();`.
